# zm — Zoom meetings and transcripts for your AI agent

These wiki pages copy the [`docs/` folder](https://github.com/WireCatLabs/zoom-cli/tree/main/docs) on
every change to `main`, so an edit made here is overwritten. To fix a page, open a pull request against
`docs/`. Start with the [README](https://github.com/WireCatLabs/zoom-cli#readme).

Questions and ideas: [Discussions](https://github.com/WireCatLabs/zoom-cli/discussions). What changed in
each version: [releases](https://github.com/WireCatLabs/zoom-cli/releases). `zm` is part of
[WireCat](https://wirecat.dev).
